agent.name: SBC Payment Agent
agent.description: Deploy a fully autonomous stablecoin wallet agent backed by the SBC Agent Payments platform. Pre-configured to check balances, send SBC, and pay for x402 and MPP-gated resources across Base, Radius, and Tempo — no code required. Includes built-in spending controls, transaction analytics, webhook management, and seller allowlists. Just add your SBC_AGENT_ID and SBC_AGENT_API_KEY secrets and start transacting.

secrets.name: SBC_AGENT_ID
secrets.description: Your agent ID from the SBC agent payments platform (agents.stablecoin.xyz → API Keys panel)

secrets.name: SBC_AGENT_API_KEY
secrets.description: Your API key from the SBC agent payments platform (agents.stablecoin.xyz → API Keys panel)
